verses.1: He said to his disciples, “It is forbidden to enter those places, unless through the doors by which one enters.”
verses.2: It helps him if a piece of wood is placed around his neck; it also prevents him from sinking into the sea, so that he won’t get crushed by those small creatures.
verses.3: Be careful with yourselves. If your brother behaves badly, then forgive him. And if he repents, then accept his repentance.
verses.4: And if he sins seven times in one day, and then returns to you saying, “I’ve repented,” then forgive him.
verses.5: And the apostles said to the Lord, “Please give us more faith.”
verses.6: The Lord said, “If you have faith like that of a little child, then you can plant it in the field. It will grow and thrive in the sea. And it will bring you benefits.”
verses.7: And those who among you have slaves who do evil or commit wrongful acts; when they go out of the village, they will be punished. They will surely fall down.
verses.8: But I still don’t know what to eat. I need to decide what to have for dinner and how to prepare it so that I can eat it safely. After that, will you be able to eat and drink with me?
verses.9: It’s not right for a slave to do what has been commanded by their master.
verses.10: In the same way, when you do everything that is required of you, you say that you are unworthy to be called slaves, because we thought we should not do those things at all.
verses.11: And during his journey to Jerusalem, he also passed through Samaria and Galilee.
verses.12: And when he entered into one of the towns, ten men met him. They stood aside to let him pass through.
verses.13: And they also cried out, “Jesus, have mercy on us!”
verses.14: And when they saw this, he said to them, “Go ahead and show yourselves to the priests.” And as they walked along, they were cleansed by God.
verses.15: But one of them, seeing that he was saved, returned with a loud voice, praising the God.
verses.16: And he fell on his face, thanksgiving being expressed by his feet. And he was a Samaritan.
verses.17: Then Jesus replied, “Have the ten become purified? Or are the nine still not purified?”
verses.18: They did not find any reason to give glory to the God, unless it was this one who was truly worthy of it.
verses.19: And he said to him, “Anastasius, go ahead. Your faith has saved you.”
verses.20: After asking when the kingdom of God would come, they were answered by the Pharisees, who said, “The kingdom of God does not come easily.”
verses.21: They won’t do anything either. Look, see! For here is the kingdom of God among you.
verses.22: He said to his disciples, “There will be days when you desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you won’t be able to see it.”
verses.23: And they will bring them to you. Look there! Look, they’re right there. Do not go away or be chased away.
verses.24: For just as the star shines from above the sky to below it, so too will the Son of Man be in that day.
verses.25: First of all, it must suffer many hardships and be rejected by this kind of family.
verses.26: And just as it happened on the days of Noe, so too will it happen on the days of the son of man.
verses.27: They married, and until one day, Noe entered the ark. Then the flood came, and everything was destroyed.
verses.28: Similarly, during those days in Loth, people ate, drank, bought and sold things, built houses, etc.
verses.29: One day, Lot left Sodom. Fire and divine punishment came from heaven, and he lost everything.
verses.30: On that day, the son of man will be revealed.
verses.31: On that day, whatever is on the house and its contents should not be left there. Similarly, those who are in the fields should not return back there either.
verses.32: You remember the woman named Loth.
verses.33: Whoever demands that his soul be taken care of will lose it. Whoever tries to destroy it will also lose it.
verses.34: I say to you, tonight, two will be placed on one chair. One will be taken away, and the other will be left behind.
verses.35: They will be two truths regarding this matter: one will be accepted, and the other will be rejected.
verses.37: And when they answered, they said to him, “Where, Lord?” But he replied to them, “Where the body is, there also will the angels be gathered.”
